quarterly_data.quarter: Magnachip Semiconductor press release: Magnachip Launches 15 New Gen6 E6 Super-Junction MOSFETs (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Launched 15 new sixth-generation (Gen6) E6 super-junction MOSFETs (500 V and 600 V) for consumer and computing power applications - TV switch-mode power supplies, notebook adapters, PC power supplies and consumer and industrial power applications below 1 kW; the 600 V lineup comes in DPAK (TO-252), TO-220FA and TO-220SFA packages. In Magnachip's own test of a 600 V, 280 mOhm E6 MOSFET in the PFC stage of a TV SMPS (100 Vac input), it ran at approximately 5.3% lower temperature than the previous-generation MOSFET. The MOSFETs are now in mass production.
quarterly_data.figure: 15 new Gen6 E6 SJ MOSFETs; 500 V and 600 V; approximately 5.3% lower temperature in a TV SMPS PFC test
